description: Search every published HelloBooks accountant profile with all public details, contacts, services, credentials and availability. No availability filter is applied by default. Follow nextPage until null to retrieve all matches. Source status distinguishes live, stale and unavailable data.

acceptingClients.description: Omit to include every published firm, including those not accepting new clients.

country.description: Directory country slug, e.g. united-states, india. Omit for all countries.

pageSize.description: Default 25. Follow nextPage until null to retrieve every matching full profile.

query.description: Search firm, principal, biography, location, specialties, industries, credentials or language.

name: list_accountants
